reasoning:
I'm checking the blade outline for self-intersections by tracing the coordinates of each point along edges to see where two segments might cross.

I find they do overlap near those coordinates, which confirms the outline is flawed since the cutting edge path loops back inside itself near the tip. Rather than patching individual points, I decide to redesign the whole blade shape as a clean crescent: a convex spine curving up to the tip on one side, with the cutting edge returning along an inward path so the two never cross.

Defining new spine coordinates...

Checking the thickness looks fine, so I just need to keep the rib and teeth as they are and swap out the blade coordinate array.
